scope_description: NFL Week 8, 2026 Regular Season — Sunday only

historical_sample.label: L10
historical_sample.definition: 10 most recent qualifying completed regular-season games

historical_cutoff.rule: Completion of the final scheduled game of Week 7
historical_cutoff.note: Stage 1 must verify that this game completed and use only qualifying games completed before its actual completion.

methodology_override.description: Select each player's available FanDuel alternate threshold strictly below locked 7P with the numerically highest American odds. FLOOR and CEILING are immediately adjacent available alternate thresholds. This overrides the default fixed price-band CORE rule.
